t: Brenner Anti-Bacterial Cleaner is a ready-to-use disinfectant liquid designed to eliminate germs on washable hard surfaces. This professional-grade formula is ideal for building sites, communal workshops, busy trade kitchens and general office cleaning. The fragrance-free liquid kills 99.9% of bacteria with zero mixing required, saving valuable time on busy jobs. Supplied in a convenient 1 Ltr bottle with a low volatile organic compound, it provides a simple and effective hygiene solution for daily maintenance.
b: Safe For Hard Surfaces Across Any Environment
